notes: Machine facts below were independently transcribed from a read-only B-unit boot_b FDT payload. See DT-HARDWARE-FACTS.md for provenance, limitations and omitted dependencies. This record is not a complete or bootable Device Tree.

board_identity.evidence: B-unit boot_b FDT reports model MediaTek evb6990_cpe_mt7990_emmc and compatibles mediatek,evb6990_cpe_mt7990_emmc / mediatek,mt6990; retail-board equivalence is not implied

runtime_fdt_provenance.evidence: Read-only B-unit boot_b FDT capture record; raw FDT and its unit-specific digest remain local

kernel_binding_validation.evidence: Linux 6.18.55 dt_binding_check and dt-doc-validate passed for mediatek.yaml; isolated dt-validate passed for the generated partial MT6990 DTB. Full MediaTek-wide checks include unrelated legacy warnings.

cpu_psci_gic_timer.evidence: Four Cortex-A55 CPU MPIDRs, PSCI SMC, GICv3 register ranges/maintenance PPI, and architected timer PPIs were transcribed to mt6990.dtsi; memory map and peripheral providers remain incomplete

peripheral_inventory.evidence: Same B-unit boot_b FDT records UART0, eMMC, three PCIe hosts/PHYs, NETSYS, MAC0/MAC1, SGMII1 and its analog PHY/PLL. A minimal independent subset is encoded with status=disabled; providers and drivers are not claimed

usable_memory_map.evidence: The same FDT has two root memory descriptions at 0x80000000 with lengths 0x3e605000 and 0x1e800000; neither is selected in the DTS
